== virtualUSB

- On Linux, `vusb export-logs` now includes the deviceBridge log in the exported archive, including rotated log files, matching the macOS client. Previously, the archive exported on Linux contained no deviceBridge log. The archive also includes the deviceBridge service journal for the requested time window.
- Logs written before the update are not included in the exported archive. Only activity recorded after the update is collected.
